narrative_prose: Silas gripped the heavy brass rail as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea sent violent tremors through the deck plates of The First Forge. The sharp tang of ionized copper filled his nose, and the dull roar of the sheer wave rattled his teeth, while the violet light cast long shadows on his aged hands. He had to DEFEND the delicate calipers from the sudden magnetic pull, quickly trying to ATTRACT Hector's attention over the cacophony. "Inefficient," he shouted over the din, holding out the heavy baton for Hector to grab, choosing not to CONCEAL his frustration as the stakes raised.
summary: Silas hands off the baton to Hector during a violent magnetohydrodynamic shear event at The First Forge.
